corrections.reason: Rejoins with previous page ending 'ይህን ያ↵ህልስ' ('ይህን ያህልስ የሚያወጣ የለኝም አላት'). The first glyph is 6th order 'ህ' (narrower top opening), not 1st order 'ሀ'.

corrections.old_text: ት ሳለ ክልብሱ ላይ ወዘ በ
corrections.corrected_text: ት ሳለ ከልብሱ ላይ ወዙ ቢ
corrections.visual_confusable_pair: ክ -> ከ, ወዘ -> ወዙ, በ -> ቢ
corrections.reason: 1) 'ከልብሱ ላይ' (1st order ከ, not ክ). 2) 'ወዙ' (his sweat, 2nd order ዙ with right side stroke). 3) 'ቢያጽቡት' (when they washed it, 3rd order ቢ wrapping to ያጽቡት, not በ).

corrections.old_text: ዝጎ እኔ ነኝ እኔ ነኝ ይባባሉ
corrections.corrected_text: ዝህ እኔ ነኝ እኔ ነኝ ይባባሉ
corrections.reason: Rejoins with L37 'የማሲ↵ዝህ' ('የማሲዝህ እኔ ነኝ እኔ ነኝ ይባባሉ ጀመሩ', i.e. 'Is it I who will betray You?'). 6th order 'ህ' was misread as 'ጎ'.
Amharic preposition 'ከነበሩ አዕባን' (from the stones that were on Mount of Olives); 1st order 'ከ' was misread as 6th order 'ክ'.
Corrupted Latin characters 'ubu' in Draft Pass 1 for Ge'ez 'የሃብዎ' (that they should give him).
The parallel reference for Matthew 26:17 in Mark is Mark 14:12 ('ማር ፲፬፥፲፪'), clearly printed as '፲፪' in the image, not '፳፪'.
Printed 'በመጀመሪያይቱ ቀን' (cf. L35-36 'በመጀመሪያ↵ይቱ'); 'ሪያይ' was misread as 'ሯዪ'.
Canonical Gospel parallel references for Matthew 26:20: Luke 22:14 ('ሉቃ ፳፪ ፲፬') and John 13:21 ('ዮሐ ፲፫፥፳፩'). In the image, '፲፬' was misread as '፲፱' and 'ዮሐ' was misread as 'ሉቃ'.
